name: Payback Billy
summary:
# Payback Time

Billy played the gig of his life and the goblins ran off with the money. Grab your crossbow, step on stage, and collect the debt one arrow at a time.

# A New Run Every Show

Roguelike runs deal you fresh ability cards from a deck of nine, each upgradeable into something nastier. Build a new flavor of chaos, spend your loot on lives and upgrades, and push one wave further than last time. Fall on stage? Start a new run and come back louder.
